name: mycrew-product
description: Layer 4/5 of the mycrew harness — the product plane: everything true about the whole product, in one repository above the sub-projects. /product-init founds it (the folder holding your sub-project repos becomes its own git repo, with a North Star drawn from you). Two endless modes then draw the product out of you and file each affirmed piece where it lives: /braindump listens while you unload and never steers, /ask-me questions you one angle at a time until the product is thought through. Both are strictly extractive — your vision and never its own; propose-idea is the one counterpart, inventing a feature, pitching it with the case for it, and filing it only on your approval. The plane's two views and the rules they obey live here: product-view for docs/product/ (what the product must do — one line per feature and nothing beneath it, with the full picture of any feature that needs one in its own file beside the list, in your words; plus the work no feature covers and what was settled and why) and design-view for docs/design/ (the one model.c4 tree and the technical choices beside it). /council is what fills that design view before the code exists — a technical council seated over the whole plane at once instead of feature by feature, so building step by step never locks in an architecture nobody chose. Its members argue in rounds and sign the draft off, so a settled decision is one they all agreed on, and whatever they could not agree on reaches you named, with both positions and the cost of each, rather than papered over. It admits only what would be expensive to reverse, says what it deliberately left open, keeps the minutes of the sitting in docs/design/councils/, and writes nothing into the plane until you have approved it. why-do-it is the gate before work starts: anything whose rightness isn't obvious goes through it and comes back GO or NO-GO with the real problem named and the better route, if there is one. pitch is the way back out: it reads the whole plane and tells you how your product works — one plain story, strictly what is written, closing with what the plane couldn't answer. Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-chief.
